title: Heading of a socio's apps on its home page. Socios are the product's AI agents; apps are small web apps they build.
failed: Shown when the socio's apps could not load.
empty-archived: Shown for an archived socio with no apps the person can open. {{name}} is the socio's name.
empty: Shown when the socio built no app the person can open. {{name}} is the socio's name.
version: In an app's details: its live version number.
shared-with: In an app's details: the Space it is shared with ({{space}}, its name; Space is a product noun).
only-you: In an app's details: shared with nobody else.
shared-by: In an app's details: who shared it with you ({{name}}).
shared-by-other: The same when the owner's name isn't known.
stage.published: Badge: the app was promoted and is published.
stage.development: Badge: the app is still being built in the socio's computer.
stage.unpublished: Badge: its owner took the app offline.
manage-hint: For screen readers, after an unpublished app's row: the link goes to the Apps page. Keep the parentheses.
new-tab-hint: For screen readers, after an app's row: the link opens a new tab. Keep the parentheses.
report: Tooltip of the button that files an issue about the app.
report-label: Accessible name of that button. {{name}} is the app's name.
